text: dsh-diff-stat 为 DSH Web 提供代码变更可视化：在 edit、write 等工具行显示新增和删除行数，并可展开对齐差异；每轮结束时汇总变更文件，支持查看文件和撤销本轮修改。差异卡片整合原生编辑与 run_code 子调用。项目已退休，且新版本内核存在兼容性限制，安装前应核对退休说明。

dsh-diff-stat visualizes DSH Web code changes with line counts, expandable diffs, and a per-turn file summary. It combines native edits and run_code subcalls, with file viewing and undo actions. Retired, with limits on newer kernels; check its notice before installing.

dsh-diff-stat 在 edit、write 等工具行展示新增与删除行数；用户展开行后可查看对齐的代码差异。
dsh-diff-stat 在每轮对话尾部汇总被修改的文件和增删行数，并把 run_code 的编辑子调用合入列表。
dsh-diff-stat opens an aligned diff in a bounded scrolling window when a user expands a changed-file row.
dsh-diff-stat offers turn-summary actions to preview, open, or undo changed files when the host API is available.
dsh-diff-stat 已退休；其轮次摘要在 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 及之后内核失效，工具行接管从 0.1.7-rc.2 起也不兼容。
dsh-diff-stat 的撤销功能对新建文件可执行删除，但覆盖旧文件时无法恢复原内容；无法验证文件创建状态时会拒绝删除。

dsh-diff-stat README · DSH Diff Stat：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin that visualizes agent file changes: inline **+N −M** badges on mutation tool rows, a per-turn file-change summary card, and full aligned diffs on click. Covers native `edit`/`write` calls, the opt-in `str_replace_editor`, and PTC dispatch sub-calls end to end. No git dependency, no third-party plugin dependencies.

dsh-diff-stat README · Features：- **Kernel target: harness ≥ 0.1.5-rc.1** — one build for that line only: the `uiConversation` event registry, `tool.call.toolview` keyed slot and `conversation.chat.turnTail` chain carry their `0.1.5-rc.1` shapes, and diff hunks are read from the tools' persisted wire `meta`. PTC dispatch arrives as `tool/ptc-dispatch(-start)`; the retired `tool/code-dispatch(-start)` spelling is still matched so a session recorded before that rename keeps its card. Older kernels are NOT supported by this version — install `dsh-diff-stat@0.1.8` (or an older release that covers them) on those kernels
- **Inline +N −M badges** — takes over the stock mutation rows for `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` (`str_replace_editor` is opt-in, off by default; keyed lower-priority shadow; uninstall restores stock). Counts are the real changed lines — the same LCS walk the diff renders — estimated from the arguments while running, exact once the result settles
- **Aligned diff window** — expanding a row opens a height-capped scrollable unified view. Both sides are LCS-aligned first: shared lines render as up to ±3 lines of context around each change, untouched runs collapse

dsh-diff-stat README · How it works：- **Badges & diffs**: registers the `edit`/`write`/`str_replace_editor` keys of the `tool.call.toolview` keyed slot at priority −1 (shadows the shipped rows; `str_replace_editor` is opt-in). Row diffs follow the applied wire meta (oldText/newText with ±3 file context) with the call-time argument fallback for PTC sub-calls, so a truncated window that dropped the call head still renders from the result meta. The turn accumulator counts the same way, including meta-only settlements
- **Turn summary card**: a `ConversationNodeDefinition` accumulator (`turn/start`, `tool/call`, `tool/result(append)`, `tool/ptc-dispatch` — and the retired `tool/code-dispatch` spelling — plus `-start` evidence) publishes Turn data; the `conversation.chat.turnTail` chain claims rendering — modeled on the official `ui-deliverables` plugin. Dispatch files join from the stock chat tool tree, whose `tool-call` nodes already fold every dispatch into its root call's `subCalls`. A pure-compute `run_code` turn with no file mutations still claims (first-wins) and renders null — accepted, the select cannot see the join result.
